pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular sub-polygonal geometries with soft-to-moderate pixel gradients at the edges. Spatial area is significantly larger on the neck and upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented and clustered shapes on the lower torso and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological web with predominantly trivalent junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is non-uniform, being narrowest between large dorsal patches and widening at the nodal intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the nuchal ridge presents a dark, high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the background, consistent with short, stiff hair texture.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct avian-shaped pixel clusters with orange-red distal tips (beaks) are perched on the neck and lower torso regions.
